name: Investment Readiness & Valuation Essentials
intro: Evaluate your readiness on cap table management, post-money valuation, SAFE notes, and due diligence.

questions.name: Question 1
questions.questiontext: What is the key advantage of a SAFE (Simple Agreement for Future Equity) note over traditional priced equity for an early-stage round?

answers.text: It defers formal corporate valuation negotiations until a qualified priced round occurs.
It requires immediate repayment with commercial interest within 12 months.
It transfers 51% board voting control immediately to the investor.
It exempts the company from local corporate tax filings.

questions.name: Question 2
questions.questiontext: If an investor invests $100,000 on a $900,000 pre-money valuation, what percentage of equity will the investor own post-money?

questions.name: Question 3
questions.questiontext: Why do tier-1 gender-lens investors prioritize clear founder vesting schedules (e.g., 4-year vesting with a 1-year cliff)?

answers.text: To ensure key founders remain committed to growing enterprise value over a sustainable time horizon.
To force founders to forfeit all salaries.
To automatically transfer shares to government regulators.
To avoid annual financial audits.

name: AfCFTA Cross-Border Trade & Customs Compliance
intro: Test your understanding of Rules of Origin, tariff lines, non-tariff barriers, and regional customs.

questions.name: Question 1
questions.questiontext: Under the AfCFTA Agreement, what is the primary role of the Certificate of Origin?

answers.text: To prove goods were wholly obtained or substantially transformed in an African state to qualify for preferential duty rates.
To replace commercial flight insurance.
To serve as a personal travel passport for corporate directors.
To mandate that all invoices be denominated exclusively in USD.

questions.name: Question 2
questions.questiontext: Which pan-African platform enables cross-border payments in local African currencies without passing through offshore correspondent banks?

answers.text: Pan-African Payment and Settlement System (PAPSS)
SWIFT Eurozone Clearing
Federal Reserve Wire Network
Euroclear Clearinghouse

name: Financial Ratios, Unit Economics & Cashflow Runway
intro: Evaluate your ability to calculate gross margins, CAC:LTV, and rolling cash runway.

questions.name: Question 1
questions.questiontext: What is a healthy Customer Lifetime Value to Customer Acquisition Cost (LTV:CAC) benchmark for a scalable business?

answers.text: At least 3:1 (LTV is three times CAC)
1:3 (CAC is three times LTV)
1:1 (Breakeven per customer)
Negative 2:1

name: Customer Acquisition, Digital Funnels & Pitch Mastery
intro: Assess customer retention, digital channels, and pitch structure.

questions.name: Question 1
questions.questiontext: What must the opening 30 seconds of an executive investor pitch primarily achieve?

answers.text: Establish the painful market problem and your unique, defensible solution clearly.
Read through the entire team resume bullet by bullet.
List every line item in the office lease agreement.
Disclose confidential supplier bank account numbers.

name: Governance, Board Structure & Legal Risk for SMEs
intro: Master board committees, advisory boards, and shareholder agreements.

questions.name: Question 1
questions.questiontext: Why is an independent non-executive director critical for early growth stage SMEs?

answers.text: They bring unbiased governance, industry connections, and objective oversight to protect all shareholders.
They take over daily operations from the founder.
They eliminate the requirement for corporate income tax payments.
They are legally prohibited from attending board meetings.

name: ESG, Impact Measurement & Pan-African Supply Chains
intro: Examine environmental sustainability, social inclusion metrics, and governance transparency.

questions.name: Question 1
questions.questiontext: How does verifiable impact reporting on female smallholder farmer inclusion enhance DFI grant and concessional debt eligibility?

answers.text: It validates gender-lens impact metrics required by development finance institutions such as AfDB and IFC.
It automatically eliminates all transport costs.
It replaces commercial bank accounts.
It waives local product liability requirements.
